plans.label: Plan 1
plans.rationale: Excellent structure otherwise: two-week taper, race-pace blocks, honest 45:00 target, no back-to-back quality. But it ignores a worsening severity-7 Achilles tendinopathy with morning limp, prescribing threshold, intervals and calf strength from week 1. Week 1 (240 min) also spikes above recent load (170-212 min). Running as written risks tendon rupture.
